o loteamento foi realizado em área de proteção de mananciais, cuja fiscalização é de sua competência.
rationale: The TJSP decision addresses state and municipal oversight liability and land-use regularization regarding an irregular subdivision located within a watershed protection zone (área de proteção de mananciais). Under the mananciais-calibrated protocol, Brazilian watershed protection (mananciais) enforcement is classified as WATER under environmental_protection. Because the summary involves land-use/subdivision enforcement and regularization in a manancial zone without direct water/sanitation utility service access or abstraction/pollution adjudication, strict_service_access_label is UNCERTAIN and involves_connection_or_informal_settlement is false.
